comparison.objective: Place three SMD components to IPC Class 3 with correct tantalum polarity versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Micro-part grasping, orientation, and precision planar placement versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, bounded tightening, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Three parts must meet pad-placement and polarity requirements; candidate requires two safe stops plus setting retention.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision, but electronics placement and polarity do not test adjustable damping. The record omits numerical IPC-derived scorer tolerances.
